def AutoDesign_Parameter():
    from recurdyn import FFlex
    from recurdyn import AutoDesign
    global model_document
    global model
    global ref_frame_1

    model_document = IModelDocument(application.ActiveModelDocument)
    model = model_document.Model
    if model is not None:
        model = ISubSystem(model)

    ref_frame_1 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    ref_frame_1.SetOrigin(0, 0, 0)

    body1 = IBody(model.CreateBodyGeneral("Body1"))
    box1 = IGeometryBox(body1.CreateBoxGeometry("Box1", ref_frame_1, 300, 200, 100))

    fflexToolkit = model.FFlexToolkit
    if fflexToolkit is not None:
        fflexToolkit = FFlex.IFFlexToolkit(fflexToolkit)

    meshMode = fflexToolkit.MeshMode
    if meshMode is not None:
        meshMode = FFlex.IMeshMode(meshMode)

    meshMode.Start(body1)
    meshOption = FFlex.IMesherMeshOption(meshMode.MeshOption(box1))
    meshOption.MeshType = FFlex.MeshType.MeshType_Shell3
    meshOption.FFlexProperty = meshOption.PropertyCollection("PShell1")
    meshOption.MaxElementSize = 30
    meshOption.MinElementSize = 10
    meshOption.UseStructuredOutput = True
    meshOption.StructuredOutput = FFlex.StructuredOutputType.StructuredOutputType_SimplePattern
    meshOption.UseCloseGaps = True
    meshOption.UseIncludeAssistModeling = True
    meshOption.ChordalErrorType = FFlex.ChordalErrorType.ChordalError_Relative
    meshOption.ChordalError = 2
    meshOption.GradationFactor = 1
    meshOption.UseQuadElementOnly = False

    meshMode.Mesh()

    fflexBody1 = FFlex.IFFlexBody(meshMode.End())
    nodeset01 = FFlex.IFFlexNodeSet(fflexBody1.CreateNodeSet("nodeset1", [50076, 50045]))
    marker01 = fflexBody1.CreateMarker("Marker1", ref_frame_1)
    if marker01 is not None:
        marker01 = IMarker(marker01)

    pv1 = IParametricValue(model.CreateParametricValue("PV1", 100))
    ex1 = IExpression(model.CreateExpression("ex1", "0"))

    autoDesign = model.AutoDesignToolkit
    if autoDesign is not None:
        autoDesign = AutoDesign.IAutoDesignToolkit(autoDesign)
    paraDirect01 = autoDesign.CreateDesignParamter("PD1", AutoDesign.DesignParameterType.DesignParameter_Direct)
    if paraDirect01 is not None:
        paraDirect01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterDirect(paraDirect01)

    paraDirect01.ParametricValue = pv1
    paraDirect01.UB = 110
    paraDirect01.LB = 50
    paraDirect01.Description = "Test"
    paraDirect01.Name = "PV01_01"
    paraDirect01.Use = True

    paraTrans01 = autoDesign.CreateDesignParamter("PD2",
                                                  AutoDesign.DesignParameterType.DesignParameter_Translational)
    if paraTrans01 is not None:
        paraTrans01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterTranslational(paraTrans01)

    paraTrans01.Name = "PD02_01"
    paraTrans01.NodeSet = nodeset01
    paraTrans01.ConfigurationDesignType = AutoDesign.ConfigurationDesignType.ConfigurationDesign_ON
    paraTrans01.RefMarker = marker01

    paraTrans01.DirectionalUnitVector.x = 1
    paraTrans01.DirectionalUnitVector.y = 1
    paraTrans01.DirectionalUnitVector.z = 1
    paraTrans01.LB = 1
    paraTrans01.UB = 10
    paraTrans01.Description = "test 2"
    paraTrans01.Use = True

    paraCylinder01 = autoDesign.CreateDesignParamter("DP3",
                                                     AutoDesign.DesignParameterType.DesignParameter_Cylindrical)
    if paraCylinder01 is not None:
        paraCylinder01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterCylindrical(paraCylinder01)

    paraCylinder01.Name = "PD03_01"
    paraCylinder01.NodeSet = nodeset01
    paraCylinder01.CenterRefMarker = marker01
    paraCylinder01.ConfigurationDesignType = AutoDesign.ConfigurationDesignType.ConfigurationDesign_ON

    paraCylinder01.CenterAxisUnitVector.x = 1
    paraCylinder01.CenterAxisUnitVector.y = 1
    paraCylinder01.CenterAxisUnitVector.z = 1

    paraCylinder01.LB = 1
    paraCylinder01.UB = 2
    paraCylinder01.Description = "test3"
    paraCylinder01.Use = True

    paraSpherical01 = autoDesign.CreateDesignParamter("DP4",
                                                      AutoDesign.DesignParameterType.DesignParameter_Spherical)
    if paraSpherical01 is not None:
        paraSpherical01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterSpherical(paraSpherical01)

    paraSpherical01.ConfigurationDesignType = AutoDesign.ConfigurationDesignType.ConfigurationDesign_ON

    paraSpherical01.Name = "PD04_01"
    paraSpherical01.NodeSet = nodeset01
    paraSpherical01.CenterRefMarker = marker01
    paraSpherical01.LB = 0.3
    paraSpherical01.UB = 5
    paraSpherical01.Description = "test4"
    paraSpherical01.Use = True

    paraAngular01 = autoDesign.CreateDesignParamter("DP5", AutoDesign.DesignParameterType.DesignParameter_Angular)
    if paraAngular01 is not None:
        paraAngular01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterAngular(paraAngular01)

    paraAngular01.ConfigurationDesignType = AutoDesign.ConfigurationDesignType.ConfigurationDesign_ON

    paraAngular01.Name = "PD05_01"
    paraAngular01.NodeSet = nodeset01
    paraAngular01.RefMarker = marker01
    paraAngular01.LB = 0.6
    paraAngular01.UB = 8
    paraAngular01.Use = True

    paraAngular01.ReferencePoint.x = 1
    paraAngular01.ReferencePoint.y = 1
    paraAngular01.ReferencePoint.z = 1

    paraAngular01.RotationAxisUnitVector.x = 1
    paraAngular01.RotationAxisUnitVector.y = 1
    paraAngular01.RotationAxisUnitVector.z = 1

    paraAngular01.Description = "test5"

    paraCollection01 = autoDesign.DesignParameterCollection
    if paraCollection01 is not None:
        paraCollection01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterCollection(paraCollection01)

    para01 = paraCollection01[0]
    if para01 is not None:
        para01 = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameter(para01)
